comment:
* Integration points with the Fragment host. *

* Fragments may be hosted by any object; such as an {@link Activity}. In order to * host fragments, implement {@link FragmentHostCallback}, overriding the methods * applicable to the host.

variables.name: mAllLoaderManagers
variables.comment: The loader managers for individual fragments [i.e. Fragment#getLoaderManager()]

variables.name: mRetainLoaders
variables.comment: Whether or not fragment loaders should retain their state

variables.name: mLoaderManager
variables.comment: The loader manger for the fragment host [i.e. Activity#getLoaderManager()]

variables.name: mLoadersStarted
variables.comment: Whether or not the fragment host loader manager was started

methods.name: public void onDump(String prefix, FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter writer, String[] args)
methods.comment:
* Print internal state into the given stream.
     *
     * @param prefix Desired prefix to prepend at each line of output.
     * @param fd The raw file descriptor that the dump is being sent to.
     * @param writer The PrintWriter to which you should dump your state. This will be closed
     *                  for you after you return.
     * @param args additional arguments to the dump request.

methods.name: public boolean onShouldSaveFragmentState(Fragment fragment)
methods.comment: * Return {@code true} if the fragment's state needs to be saved.

methods.name: public abstract E onGetHost()
public void onSupportInvalidateOptionsMenu()
methods.comment:
* Invalidates the activity's options menu.
     * See {@link FragmentActivity#supportInvalidateOptionsMenu()}

methods.name: public void onStartActivityFromFragment(Fragment fragment, Intent intent, int requestCode)
methods.comment:
* Starts a new {@link Activity} from the given fragment.
     * See {@link FragmentActivity#startActivityForResult(Intent, int)}.

methods.name: public void onStartActivityFromFragment(Fragment fragment, Intent intent, int requestCode, @Nullable Bundle options)
methods.comment:
* Starts a new {@link Activity} from the given fragment.
     * See {@link FragmentActivity#startActivityForResult(Intent, int, Bundle)}.

methods.name: public void onRequestPermissionsFromFragment(@NonNull Fragment fragment, @NonNull String[] permissions, int requestCode)
methods.comment:
* Requests permissions from the given fragment.
     * See {@link FragmentActivity#requestPermissions(String[], int)}

methods.name: public boolean onShouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(@NonNull String permission)
methods.comment:
* Checks wehter to show permission rationale UI from a fragment.
     * See {@link FragmentActivity#shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(String)}

methods.name: public boolean onHasWindowAnimations()
methods.comment: * Return {@code true} if there are window animations.

methods.comment: retain -- whether to stop the loader or retain it
